title: d-FCT (Decentralized Fact-Checking Toolkit): A Cardano-Based Ecosystem for Transparent, Community-Driven Fact Verification

ms.promise:
Technical report with smart contract design and platform architecture
We will write a technical report discussing the overall platform architecture, including Web2’s backend (Python) and frontend (ReactJS) components, as well as the proposed on-chain approach. This report will outline use cases and requirements, along with functionality and objectives of smart contracts in the platform. The on-chain approach will focus on discussing operations that require immutability and decentralization. That is, registering contribution scoring (topic creation, evidence and content submission, voting on topic claims, reviewing claims, etc.), reward distribution (ensuring contributors are compensated based on verified contribution scores), governance mechanisms, among others.
Off-chain components will discuss how to handle resource-intensive tasks and dynamic operations. Fact-checking analysis, content processing including AI and human review workflows, will be conducted off-chain, with results fed into on-chain when appropriate. ms.promise:
Provenance, or the verification of the origin and history of the content, is crucial for the d-FCT platform. In this milestone, we will implement smart contract (output 1) and backend features (output 2) to ensure the authenticity and traceability of contributions made by users. In the smart contract side, this involves creating components to log transactions with submission's history using blockchain immutability, tracking user inputs, votes, and evidence provided for each fact-checked item. This will use Cardano’s blockchain to ensure transparency and accountability across the verification process. The use cases and programming language used to implement the smart contract will be defined in the Milestone 1 technical report. The backend features include server-side endpoints and components for keeping necessary metadata described in the Milestone 1 technical report in a relational database (i.e. postgresql).
・smart contract for provenance
・backend features for provenance
ms.criteria:
・Smart contract has mechanisms supporting verification of the origin and history of each topic, claim, and content.
・The backend features are capable to ensure the authenticity and traceability of contributions by users, through the use of the smart contract [1]

ms.promise:
Governance is a critical part of ensuring d-FCT remains a decentralized, community-driven platform. We will implement a governance smart contract (Output 1) and voting mechanisms (Output 2) that allow users to influence key decisions. This includes implementing backend and frontend components that enable users to vote on fact-checking processes, platform rules, and updates to the scoring and reward system. We will also implement a reputation system to weigh votes based on user expertise and contribution history. The use cases and programming language used to implement the smart contract will be defined in the Milestone 1 technical report.
・smart contract for governance
・frontend and backend features for governance
